summary: Optionally publish the ISO as an OCI artifact next to the bootc image: chown the output dir to your user, set OCI_DISK_IMAGE_REPO=${OCI_IMAGE_REPO}/diskimage-iso, podman manifest create, then podman manifest add --artifact --artifact-type application/vnd.diskimage.iso --arch=amd64 --os=linux with install.iso.
